==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I went rock boarding through the sky. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Rock boarding is the use of geomancy to fly through the sky on a piece of stone shaped like a surfboard.) A panicked were-dragon accidentally crashed into me, and we both fell into the forest below. (Were-dragons resemble humanoid dragons, covered in scales, with whiskers and antenna.) (The specific were-dragon that crashed into me was covered in red scales, with yellow whiskers, and yellow antenna.) The were-dragon was banished from his clan for being a hybrid, so I offered him sanctuary at the academy. (I am specifically referring to the Magic Hero Academy.) (The Magic Hero Academy resembles three towers of white stone in a row, with the center tower being taller than the other two adjacent towers.)
